reason: The price is actually on the page and 59 € a month is not the problem, but I am not letting an AI write to my customers or touch my CRM on the strength of 'GDPR-compliant' in one line. I might book the demo or poke at the free plan, but I would not pay this month.
objection: What happens when the AI support manager tells a customer something wrong, and where exactly is our customer data stored and processed? I need to see that it asks me before sending anything and that the data stays in the EU.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own data showing every outgoing message waits for my approval, plus a signed DPA with EU hosting and a reference from a similar Belgian or French SME.
